Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber. We purchased our first one in 1995 and have been using it since.  Still love that one, but it was time to get a new one.  Our new Spirit II is pretty amazing. It's heats up quickly and the cooking times are great.  Even if you pack the grill with hamburgers or corn on the cob, the heating seems to be very uniform. The soft touch is nice controls knobs are great but my only suggestion would be a notable 'click', or something, to let you know the burners where all off.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We suggest letting the grill set for approximately 10-15 minutes to allow the grill to preheat properly. 

Your grill should be able to reach the same high temperature we expect from all of our grills, at least 450 F. If your grill is not getting that hot, we would suggest double-checking your current gas pressure.  The gas pressure provided (from the tank) to the grill is of the utmost importance, it affects the performance of the burner tubes. 

Our kind Support team would like to follow up with you. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
